scope: Read-only audit of 23 recent development/checkpoint units. New authored audit files only. No patient or generated row tables opened, no target-input files opened, no new generation, testing, web search, refitting or frozen artifact edits.
source_precision: Exact core/cross-task primary CSV values, quality diagnostic JSON, iron source-replay aggregates, conditional-evidence algebra JSON and source-conditioned replay aggregate values were inspected. Other figures are report-level rounded values; no new statistical recomputation was performed.

grade_definition.A_bounded_analysis_utility: Relatively strong local evidence for specified analytical uses, with counterresults and developmental/exposure limits retained; not a clinical validity certification.
grade_definition.B_bounded_capability: Observed construction, retrieval/execution, mathematical, repair or source-replay capability, or a small mixed comparative pilot.
grade_definition.C_retrieval_or_diagnostic: Useful source acquisition, planning, diagnostic or retrospective interpretation without new generated-data efficacy.
grade_definition.D_setup_only: Setup/provisioning or failure checkpoint; no scientific efficacy observations.

recommended_paper_focus: An Agent converts heterogeneous scientific evidence and explicit analysis requests into complete, inspectable virtual cohorts; final outputs preserve useful requested associations in several settings, while source-conditioned execution and deterministic checks distinguish what evidence actually supports from assumption-dependent joint structure. Treat reusable construction and analysis-specific utility as the main contribution, with autonomy/retrieval and verification as supporting mechanisms.

strongest_three.claim: Repeatable analysis-specific whole-cohort utility across multiple requests and authored laws
strongest_three.evidence: Core 4 authors/12 tables: 36/36 direction agreements across six definitions. Cross-task 6 authors/18 tables: 54/54 across six definitions. The CHNS reduced-model BMI discrepancy has real-real median 0.007239 versus virtual-real 0.004383–0.012727.
strongest_three.counterevidence: Full covariance/dispersion utility is not established; lipid residual correlations 0.108–0.141 versus 0.512; iron OR 4.835–6.565 versus 17.79. Do not select different winning authors for different endpoints.

strongest_three.claim: Agents actually use numerical evidence to build consistent, flexible joint laws
strongest_three.evidence: Four artificial-fixture authors derive coefficients (0.25, 0.65, -0.40) and residual variance 0.6775. Latest shared source/target generator computes 24/24 projections of eight source slopes, with direction agreement and independent arithmetic agreement, then yields three complete coherent scenario tables.
strongest_three.counterevidence: Extra joint instruction provides zero gain; artificial arm outputs share one law/six tables. All 24 source replay strict semantics remain unavailable, and no new target validation was done. The source-increment revision improves full BMI but worsens reduced BMI and dispersion.

strongest_three.claim: Bounded scientific autonomy is observed, with inspection and repair linked to actual outputs
strongest_three.evidence: Adaptive case: 28 dispatched actions, real retrieval, two source-dependent models and six tables, followed by a pre-reference retain decision. Coherence case: 16/9000 violations become 0/9000 via Agent-selected repair, with all 156 endpoint checks independently reproduced.
strongest_three.counterevidence: Host still launches authors and reviews evidence; author-wide isolation is procedural. Adaptive selected-final gain is zero; projection creates 16 exact boundaries and source agreement is mixed. No end-to-end cost/time benefit or general revision superiority is measured.

deduplication_rules: Core evaluation_v2 repairs scalar serialization on the same 12 frozen tables; it is not a second experiment.
Request_entry is provisioning; agent_system_live is actual generation. Live initial/final labels contain six distinct delivery tables, not twelve.
gap_search -> evidence_to_generation -> real_real_calibration is acquisition, one generated model and a reused-table evaluation chain.
quality_attribution reuses core_workflow; analysis_use_diagnosis reuses multiple historical cases. Neither adds generated cohorts.
evidence_gap_actions -> supplement_probe -> source_increment_revision is planning, acquisition, then one new revision, not three replications.
controlled_joint_moments has four authored programs, one probability law, twelve deliveries and six distinct numerical tables.
analysis_use_rubric v1 failure and v2 corrected setup form one repair experiment. v1 has zero authors/executions.

retrieval_validation_analysis is a read-only diagnosis, followed by adaptive_evidence implementation. conditional_evidence is source acquisition followed by source_conditioned_replay; stage counts must remain separate.

Core, cross-task, rubric pilot and adaptive iterations reuse CHNS/ENSANUT/Turkana/NHANES families with overlapping sources. Fresh contexts or seeds do not reset clinical exposure or create new study families.
Source strata, shared papers, seed draws, per-endpoint statistics and audit comparisons are separate denominators. Do not sum them into a success rate or independent validation count.

records.input_setting: External literature selected by four fresh-context scientific authors; population/analysis requests visible; no supplied participant rows, target outcomes, desired signs, DOI seeds or earlier constructions. CHNS and ENSANUT were already exposed project references. Repaired evaluation_v2 reuses the same frozen tables.
records.comparison: All prespecified endpoint estimates versus existing CHNS/ENSANUT sample aggregates, retaining every author and seed.
records.strongest_supported_finding: A common open-evidence workflow repeatedly yielded complete, analyzable cohorts across two requests, preserving all six requested association directions across four distinct Agent-selected constructions. ENSANUT BMI attenuation after glucose adjustment recurred in every draw from both laws.

numeric_support.direction_agreements: 36/36 estimates; six definitions, not 36 independent relationships

counterresults: Both CHNS age effects too weak; both ENSANUT age effects too strong relative to the existing samples.
C01 glucose–HbA1c Pearson approximately 0.666 versus 0.661 but Spearman approximately 0.635 versus 0.361.
ENSANUT residual RMS approximately 0.295/0.324 versus 0.488; SD approximately 0.362/0.406 versus 0.527.
No scientific revision occurred; no retrieval-benefit control. Original evaluator failure is a repaired evaluation checkpoint, not a new scientific replication.
records.inference_scope: Developmental multi-construction evidence of analysis-specific utility and flexible numerical modeling; not new external clinical validation, independent-source convergence, complete joint fidelity or end-to-end efficiency.
records.paper_role: Recent main positive result; display all four constructions and all six primary analyses together, with dispersion/rank counterresults.

records.input_setting: Fresh constructor used reviewed evidence from gap_search, a six-column Chinese adult whole-cohort request and no participant input/target outcomes. Sex-stratified Gaussian copula with bounded age and positive margins; developmental CHNS comparison.
records.comparison: Prespecified reduced/full regressions, marginals and correlations versus existing CHNS aggregates; deterministic sensitivity of unreported BMI–glucose dependence.
records.strongest_supported_finding: The open-search source packet was actually converted into an executable complete-cohort law with useful reduced-model associations and analysis-specific sensitivity diagnostics.
counterresults: Full BMI range 0.00380–0.01811 versus 0.02246; glucose 0.28417–0.31368 versus 0.39291; female point sign differs.
Close HbA1c mean/SD coexist with q90 approximately 6.914–6.955 versus 6.3 and rank/dependence mismatch.
Only one law; no revision. Historical contrast with live B changes author, sources, description, law and seeds together.
records.inference_scope: Single-case source-to-data capability and positive descriptive utility; no isolated causal effect of freer retrieval.
records.paper_role: Concrete provenance-rich example linking source discovery to scientific model and usable analyses; pair with unsupported-dependence sensitivity.

records.input_setting: Fresh acquisition Agent received an intended conditional HbA1c regression and population metadata with no preset DOI list or desired coefficient/sign; source-only bounded search.
records.comparison: Evidence packet quality versus prior abstract-only access, not a controlled retrieval-policy comparison.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Agent-selected queries and publisher follow-up recovered genuine numeric conditional evidence and distinguished incompatible estimands instead of treating all reported associations alike.
counterresults: LifeLines has extra covariates, different population/measurement and unresolved CI/coding details; no direct target coefficient identified.
Hoorn quartile contrasts, Sakane undefined-scale Beta and Hainan diagnostic logistic quantities are not interchangeable continuous HbA1c slopes.
No generator or outcome evaluation in this unit; source packet is reused in evidence_to_generation.
records.inference_scope: Observed flexible acquisition and statistical interpretation; not generated-data improvement.
records.paper_role: Mechanistic source-access evidence supporting the workflow narrative; count as upstream stage, not another generation experiment.

records.input_setting: Post-evaluation deterministic checks of frozen laws, source summaries and core_workflow evaluation_v2 aggregates.
records.comparison: Generated estimates against theoretical law implications and old reference aggregates; source internal moment compatibility.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Several key estimates closely follow their declared laws, so these discrepancies can be localized to model/transport choices rather than assumed sampler failure; audit also exposes incompatibility among printed source summaries.
counterresults: No causal percentage of error can be assigned to evidence, population selection, structure or transport.
Closest source SD does not imply closest target SD; source printed moments cannot all be imposed as exact common-context OLS constraints.
Reanalysis of core_workflow, not independent replication.
records.inference_scope: Mathematical/diagnostic validity only; does not improve generated data.
records.paper_role: Mechanism explanation that strengthens interpretation of useful and discrepant outputs without inventing an efficacy result.

records.input_setting: Previously exposed CHNS reference resplit descriptively; three already frozen evidence_to_generation tables reused unchanged.
records.comparison: Median real-real absolute differences versus median symmetric generated-real discrepancies across fixed tables; different sampling constructions, not exchangeable tests.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Several ordinary regression effects in the frozen virtual cohort have discrepancies on the same numerical scale as within-CHNS resplit variation, giving a useful data-driven context for analysis-specific agreement.
counterresults: B glucose discrepancy 0.079642–0.109154 versus real-real 0.023839; B female 0.077716–0.117915 versus 0.021398.
Female proportion and upper glucose/HbA1c quantiles remain substantially different.
100 dependent finite-sample resplits are not 100 cohorts, equivalence thresholds or between-population validation.
records.inference_scope: Descriptive within-sample context for already observed utility; no new generation or clinical study family.
records.paper_role: Strong contextual support for the existing useful-regression example; keep larger conditional/tail discrepancies alongside it.

records.input_setting: Six fresh-context constructors on ENSANUT HbA1c and Turkana lipid requests, curated external sources plus optional literature tools; no participant inputs or target outcomes; previously exposed references.
records.comparison: All six requested relationships and 51 diagnostic definitions across all authors/seeds versus available frozen sample references.
records.strongest_supported_finding: The same workflow supports whole-cohort construction across glycemia and lipid tasks with multiple self-selected laws, preserving every primary point-estimate direction and explicit evidence-to-parameter reasoning.
counterresults: H03 closer adjusted BMI comes with narrower HbA1c SD/RMS; H02 preserves more spread but smaller BMI effects.
All lipid residual correlations are far below the sample reference; all HDL SDs approximately 14.4–14.6 versus 20.18.
TC reference interval includes zero. All source checks unavailable; no measured source-fit feedback or revision gain.
Shared model service/workflow/overlapping sources; six constructions do not constitute six new clinical studies.
records.inference_scope: Developmental cross-task qualitative utility and observed modeling flexibility; no global winner, transport guarantee or causal component benefit.
records.paper_role: Main recent breadth result; retain complete author columns and companion dispersion panel rather than selecting a different winner for each endpoint.

records.input_setting: Two authors generated Hb/ferritin for nonpregnant women using external band/threshold evidence; target outcomes sealed until acquisition, but NHANES already exposed at project level.

actual_scale.source_replay_note: A initial and final use the same threshold/rank construction; these entries are not new clinical replications. Final-table count excludes source draws.

records.comparison: Same rows evaluated for threshold OR, joint-low prevalence and continuous Spearman against design-based NHANES reference; source replay separately assessed.
records.strongest_supported_finding: A single virtual cohort supports threshold and continuous analyses; the retained results reveal specific useful properties: A joint-low burden within about one percentage point, B continuous ranks within about 0.03, while neither supports the target threshold effect magnitude.
counterresults: Every generated OR lies below even the lower target interval bound 9.28.
A's closer prevalence and B's closer rank are different-model successes, not a composite best dataset.
A upper-tail finite-moment repair is mathematical validity, not demonstrated endpoint-score improvement; source OR fit did not transfer to target OR.
records.inference_scope: Developmental analytical breadth with distinct source/target interpretations; no new independent study family or universal model.
records.paper_role: Strong mixed breadth example: preserve both complete model profiles; do not cherry-pick A prevalence plus B correlation as one method output.

records.input_setting: Fresh constructor revised existing E01 using newly acquired Skogberg supplement; static prior model allowed but target outcomes/rows not supplied; code unchanged, seven scientific parameters changed.
records.comparison: New model versus old E01 means and existing ENSANUT reference; different seed schedules, not randomized matched-policy comparison.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Actual numerical evidence changed the scientific law and its downstream projections, making evidence use observable; glucose-adjusted BMI agreement improved in this realization.
counterresults: Reduced BMI effect moved farther from reference and already narrow residual/total variation narrowed further.
Conditional scale and slopes require unit, projection, weighting and transport assumptions; new source was not exactly replayed.
All 93 numerical endpoints agreed with independent implementation, supporting the declared mechanism but not clinical superiority.
records.inference_scope: Single developmental evidence-intervention mechanism with mixed final utility.
records.paper_role: Use as an evidence-to-model causal-chain illustration with both beneficial and adverse outcomes; not as a default improvement claim.

records.input_setting: Source-only retrospective action planning on C01/C02/E01/E02 with fresh authors and unchanged frozen inputs.
records.comparison: Declared use/evidence gaps mapped to allowed actions; local source re-extraction independently verified.
records.strongest_supported_finding: The workflow can turn an analytical evidence gap into a concrete source action; one local re-read recovered useful subgroup SDs and located actionable supplements.
counterresults: HGI-defined subgroup SDs are not full-model residual SDs.
All 18 retrieval proposals correctly blocked by frozen/closed sessions; only one actual local action executed.
66 cards/120 gaps are repeated declarations, not executed actions, efficacy observations or new independent scientific problems.
records.inference_scope: Action-planning and extraction capability; no generated-data quality outcome.
records.paper_role: Upstream mechanism appendix; count once in the supplement-to-revision development chain.

records.input_setting: One previously located official legacy .doc supplement acquired/converted and source-reviewed; no new cohort construction.
records.comparison: Source information newly extracted relative to old packet's R-squared-only use.
records.strongest_supported_finding: A real access/format obstacle was removed and signed continuous coefficients were recovered; source interpretation review corrected an overconfident unit label.
counterresults: HbA1c regression unit not explicitly printed; percentage-point interpretation remains a working assumption.
No glucose-adjusted BMI effect or conditional residual SD; source population/age/weighting differ.
Positive-root evidence largely confirms an old assumption; no automatic parameter change or performance gain within this unit.
records.inference_scope: Targeted evidence acquisition and semantics correction only.
records.paper_role: Upstream source increment for the actual revision; avoid counting acquisition and generation as independent replications.

records.input_setting: Artificial four-variable fixture; 15 exact population summaries supplied to two ordinary and two extra-instruction authors; joint coefficients and residual variance not directly supplied.
records.comparison: Ordinary scientific construction versus additional joint-consistency instruction; all author-seed outputs retained.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Ordinary Agents already inferred the joint coefficients and residual variance from separately adjusted associations and produced a source-compatible joint generator.
counterresults: Both arms yield identical law and identical six numerical tables, paired by RNG layout; no instruction-effect evidence.
Exact consistent summaries identify linear projections, not the full law or tails.
Artificial task does not test paper extraction, incompatible populations, retrieval, feedback or clinical transfer.
records.inference_scope: Strong mathematical construction capability under informative inputs; one artificial law, not biomedical validation.
records.paper_role: Positive mechanism anchor showing numerical evidence can be used effectively without additional architecture; report null component comparison.

records.input_setting: Retrospective read-only synthesis of frozen reconstruction, HRS, glycemia, iron, lipids and earlier prospective HAALSI, plus deterministic law calculations.
records.comparison: Analysis-level uses across information settings; law implications versus existing aggregate results.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Clarifies that some complete tables support useful requested associations and richer longitudinal analyses while their unsupported conditional/dispersion uses can be named precisely.
counterresults: Age-profile completion does not repair narrow H03 dispersion under the tested approximation.
Summary-assisted reconstruction uses 30 supplied target summaries; its agreement is not external prediction.
HRS weak upper interaction is not stable across Agent and corrected published-law draws; original prospective HAALSI stop must remain.
Reuses earlier cases; diagnosis is not independent efficacy replication or a generator improvement.
records.inference_scope: Analysis-use mapping and mathematical attribution, with no new data.
records.paper_role: Use to organize claims by input access and estimand; do not count its re-listed results again.

records.input_setting: Two existing cases, matched source packet per case; base versus supplied rubric versus rubric plus reusable procedure; one fresh author per case-condition, no retrieval/trial/revision.
records.comparison: Three guidance conditions across every scheduled analysis and diagnostic; previously exposed references.
records.strongest_supported_finding: All conditions yielded analyzable full cohorts and the same six qualitative point-direction patterns; rubric-only had a locally better glucose-adjusted BMI comparison, while extra procedures added no consistent gain.
counterresults: Rubric-only better coefficient accompanies worse HbA1c SD; all conditional RMS and HDL SD remain narrower.
All lipid residual correlations near 0.13 versus 0.5121.
One author per condition/case, prompt-length and unmeasured compute differences prevent causal rubric effect or global superiority claims.
Same exposed cases and source families as cross-task; fresh runs are developmental instruction comparisons, not new cohorts.
records.inference_scope: Small controlled-input development pilot showing useful directional outputs and mixed local instruction differences.
records.paper_role: Retain as null/mixed component study; do not make guidance efficacy the central paper claim.

records.input_setting: One fresh Agent used archived experimental skill on fictional A/B/C planning task with staged marginal versus joint evidence.
records.comparison: Behavior across progressively informative evidence; no baseline arm.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Agent distinguished marginal from adjusted dependence, declined irrelevant marginal-shape revision, and used informative joint evidence correctly.
counterresults: No generated tables, biomedical validation or skill-effect comparator.
Subsequent calibration wording fix was not behaviorally retested by this same run.
Dispersion and longitudinal procedures untested.
records.inference_scope: Single planning/math behavioral demonstration.
records.paper_role: Prototype lineage only; not another clinical result or evidence for default skill efficacy.

records.input_setting: Fresh-session setup failed because inherited web-source namespace lacked approvals; preserved before author dispatch/actions.
records.comparison: No scientific comparison; corrected setup continued in analysis_use_rubric_v2.

counterresults: No scientific construction, generated data or outcome evidence in v1.
records.inference_scope: Setup checkpoint only.
records.paper_role: Failure-accounting footnote linked to v2, never an independent experiment.

records.input_setting: One existing lipid law plus optional Agent-selected repair; source-grounded HDL<=TC concentration rule provided; no real-target outcome reads.
records.comparison: Baseline versus midpoint projection of violating pairs under common proposed draws; all analyses and side effects retained.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Agent reacted to execution-linked coherence feedback and implemented a concrete repair with fully retained numerical consequences.
counterresults: Projection creates 16 exact TC=HDL boundaries with unvalidated biological frequency.
Source agreement is mixed and all 29 strict source checks per table remain unavailable.
Generic consistency repair adds no conditional joint evidence and was not compared with target outcomes.
Original v1 setup failure and v2 recovery are one unit; underlying baseline is from the adaptive-evidence development lineage.
records.inference_scope: Engineering/scientific consistency repair for the declared latent-concentration scenario; not measured clinical accuracy improvement.
records.paper_role: Specific feedback-response example with side effects; keep subordinate to final-data utility.

records.input_setting: Fresh scientific author chose queries, evidence interpretations, joint model, parameters, generated-only calculations, sensitivity and selection on an existing lipid request; source packet/schema/budgets provided.
records.comparison: Retained initial versus source-dependent sensitivity, evaluated after closure against existing sample aggregates.
records.strongest_supported_finding: An actual retrieval–construction–execution–inspection–revision/retention loop ran, with scientific choices made by the author and a nontrivial evidence-driven dependence sensitivity.
counterresults: Sensitivity improved residual-correlation point proximity while worsening TC slope proximity; initial retained before evaluation.
No demonstrated final quality gain, and 204 strict unavailable records are not successful calibration.
Host launches model; author wider-tool isolation is procedural, not OS enforcement; only generator isolated.
One exposed lipid case; 3/6 query units and 2/3 downloads used, so cap exhaustion did not cause stopping.
records.inference_scope: Observed bounded autonomy and useful scenario construction, without general autonomy/revision efficacy.
records.paper_role: Best actual autonomy example; show action-to-model-to-analysis chain with retained decision, not just a workflow diagram.

records.input_setting: Fresh author with broader public web ingestion and strict plus descriptive feedback; two papers and official manufacturer page retrieved for existing lipid case.
records.comparison: All requested analyses versus existing sample; historical comparison with prior adaptive_case run changes author/model/sources/seeds together.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Broader evidence types and explicit assumption-labelled diagnostics were actually used end-to-end, giving useful numeric feedback where strict semantics remained unresolved.
counterresults: Closer TC slope/HDL SD coexist with farther HDL slope/TC SD and persistent residual-correlation gap.
11 HDL>TC pairs and device-range exceedances are retained; current strip limits are not automatic physiological bounds.
29 strict checks per table remain unavailable. Native discovery is logged but not fully controller-metered.
Retained initial; no revision gain or causal interface-effect estimate.
records.inference_scope: Interface capability and partial descriptive final utility on one exposed case.
records.paper_role: Evidence-use implementation progression, not an additional independent cohort or global improvement.

records.input_setting: Read-only reassessment of adaptive_case source-check declarations/operator support plus literature-method memo; no new experiment.
records.comparison: Unavailable strict source checks dissected into computable descriptive analogues versus genuine estimator/data gaps.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Audit identifies a tractable implementation bottleneck: many unavailable source checks still admit useful, explicitly qualified descriptive calculation.
counterresults: 28 analogues are not newly passed source checks; all were deliberately declared unavailable before calculation.
Descriptive conventions cannot identify missing adjusted covariance or justify population transfer.
No new generation or quality outcome; proposals were implemented/tested only in separately recorded later units.
records.inference_scope: Diagnostic correction and design rationale only.
records.paper_role: Explains why dual feedback was needed; avoid counting availability records as independent scientific validation.

records.input_setting: One fresh author chose a shared source/target HDL+non-HDL law; Soares source strata include source-specific nuisance variables and eight BMI coefficients. No reference-outcome reads.
records.comparison: Source-specific full regression replay under declared standardization/weighting conventions; downstream target-scenario calculations without clinical reference comparison.
records.strongest_supported_finding: A scientific Agent operationalized study-specific continuous relationships through the same source/target program, executed all source projections, then delivered complete coherent target-scenario tables.
counterresults: All 24 strict semantic checks still unavailable because weighting/BMI standardization unresolved; numerical replay is assumption-labelled.
Correct source slopes are largely expected from conditional-mean construction; source fit does not validate transport.
Changing unresolved component coupling permits conditional correlation roughly -0.46 to +0.87 with fixed slopes.
No clinical-reference evaluation: do not compare 0.375712 to old 0.5121 as a new accuracy improvement; target residual use remains unassessed.
records.inference_scope: Strong source-consistency and coherent whole-cohort capability; no new clinical utility validation or feedback benefit.
records.paper_role: Strongest latest numerical source-to-generator link; separate source projection panel from downstream scenario outcomes.

records.input_setting: Source-only audit of continuous lipid/BMI associations and joint evidence with independent review; no candidate or target/generated row access.
records.comparison: Newly verified conditional/joint evidence versus earlier qualitative/marginal packet; algebra on three published rounded correlations.
records.strongest_supported_finding: Useful continuous source coefficients and a genuine partial-correlation triplet were recovered, enabling an explicit quantitative follow-on rather than vague qualitative dependence assumptions.
counterresults: Soares 2019/2020 overlap; do not treat as independent corroboration.
Liu result remains age/sex/batch-adjusted with common-record/design uncertainty and German-to-African transport issues.
Rounding interval is not a CI, target estimate or clinical validation; residual scale/joint law remains unidentified.
Upstream evidence stage for source_conditioned_replay, not an extra generation result.

records.paper_role: Link newly found information to subsequent source replay, preserving adjustment/measurement assumptions.

records.input_setting: Two fresh author contexts, two related glycemia requests, three supplied bibliographic identifiers; no participant inputs/target outcomes/signs. Host-dispatched program generation.
records.comparison: All prespecified reduced/full CHNS regression coefficients and diagnostics; initial/final aliases are identical deliveries.

counterresults: Full BMI requested effect wrong point direction; full age much too weak and female opposite uncertain reference point sign.
Close Pearson/glucose mean did not ensure adjusted analytical use.
Bibliographic seeds supplied; no open-ended discovery or feedback-revision benefit.
